response.overview: I spent the whole winter on Jeju Island, filming the weather each day. Each time the strong winter winds blew, they gave rise to different forms of movement across the land and sky. With the camera fixed on the landscape, I sought to capture how movement could transform the entire frame into something altogether different. Waiting for such a transformation felt like a ritual, and so the film was titled “Jaeiseol” (災異說).
response.title: Jaeiseol Part 1
